conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with lower volatility. Expect modest monthly gains around 1.5% with reduced drawdown risk. Significant cash buffer provides safety.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to small positions.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and create buffer.
Buy RGTI as a new, high-scoring long setup.

balanced.read: This plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% monthly. It balances broad index exposure with quality tech and a small allocation to leveraged ETFs. Drawdowns are managed by trimming concentration and adding new setups.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 6% each.
Buy RGTI as a new, high-scoring long setup at 6%.
Increase CRWD to 15% to press strength.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. Expect higher potential gains but also significantly larger drawdowns and amplified risk due to leverage and daily decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
